objective: Produce the bounded plan, owner integration, product/operator states, and proof bundle for the ADR 0001 product-memory successor boundary: one memory runtime owning working, core and archival layers, thread and typed checkpoint mirrors, background enrichment, and retrieval, with every durable change admitted through Agentgres operations and no live SCS product-memory path remaining; M8_PRODUCT_MEMORY_RUNTIME_SUCCESSOR_EXIT=0.
falsifiable_claim: This plan is incomplete or its future claim fails if a product-memory read, checkpoint, enrichment output, retrieval result, or evidence blob reaches a consumer without an admitted owner record; if a runtime checkpoint is consumed as a policy or consensus input; if a prompt-time secret is stored in always-injected core memory; if a live SCS product-memory path or an SCS-to-successor importer survives; or if adapter-local memory is presented as durable memory truth.

in_scope: `LEARNING`, `AGENTGRES`, `DAEMON`, `STORAGE`, `SECURITY`; MemorySpace and MemoryProjection record families, working/core/archival layer ontology, thread and typed checkpoint mirrors, background enrichment outputs (summaries, facts, entities, embeddings), retrieval, compaction, and local evidence blobs.

The runtime-versus-admitted-truth boundary stated by ADR 0001: memory reads, checkpoints, retrieval and compaction are runtime/operational state; durable change is admitted through Agentgres operations; committed chain state remains authoritative for policy enforcement, firewall checks, and approval or gate readiness.
Named disposition of every remaining SCS product-memory reference in the repository, including the explicit no-importer migration policy.

Positive, adversarial, stale-state, substitution, fault, recovery, product/operator-state, and retained-evidence planning for the bounded claim.

implementation_actions: Resolve and freeze the exact canonical owner and contract revision for MemorySpace and MemoryProjection; if canon does not define an owner path for the memory runtime itself (as distinct from the portable vault bundle format), stop and route the question to the canon owner rather than inventing one.
Build the honest inventory of remaining SCS product-memory references across crates and docs with a per-reference disposition (retire, rename, keep-as-history) and no deletion claim before proof.
Implement or bind the layer, checkpoint, enrichment, and retrieval crossings needed for the declared claim, with each durable change admitted through an Agentgres operation.

Build positive plus adversarial/fault runners that reject unadmitted memory reads, checkpoint-as-policy-input, secret-in-core-memory, adapter-local-cache-as-truth, and surviving SCS product-memory paths.
Retain an evidence index and require the exact content-bound M8_PRODUCT_MEMORY_RUNTIME_SUCCESSOR_EXIT=0; never infer success from a task or process exit code.
consequential_effects_and_final_invokers: effect: durable memory admission, compaction, or enrichment write | final_invoker: Agentgres operation admission path | authority_source: local/domain policy and applicable grant; the memory runtime originates no authority | receipt_or_evidence: operation log entry and receipt, with no memory-runtime-local receipt accepted as a substitute | negative_behavior: deny unadmitted write, deny secret-bearing core-memory injection, deny any checkpoint consumed as a policy input
positive_proof: The selected profile completes the bounded product-memory journey - write, admit, enrich, retrieve, compact, and reconstruct - through the declared owner path and produces the exact expected truth, effect, and evidence outputs.
Restart, replay, or independent reconstruction preserves the same owner refs, heads/roots, receipts, and explicit nonclaims.
The retained evidence file contains exactly one line equal to M8_PRODUCT_MEMORY_RUNTIME_SUCCESSOR_EXIT=0 only after the full claim is independently reviewed.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Reject and retain evidence for an unadmitted memory read or write reaching a consumer.
Reject and retain evidence for a runtime checkpoint consumed as a policy, firewall, or approval-readiness input.
Reject and retain evidence for a prompt-time secret placed in always-injected core memory.
Reject and retain evidence for adapter-local cache presented as durable memory truth after a model, harness, or provider swap.
Reject and retain evidence for a surviving live SCS product-memory path or any SCS-to-successor importer.
Include substitution, stale-state, denial, dependency-loss, retry/ambiguity, restart, and recovery branches.
compatibility_and_migration: ADR 0001 forbids an SCS-to-successor importer for product state; migration is clean replacement, and any remaining raw-state reader must document why it is consensus-sensitive.
Preserve existing valid object, route, receipt, and evidence identities until an explicit owner-approved successor exists.
No fixture, cache, adapter-local store, or compatibility layer becomes a second memory truth or authority owner.
